textbookText: Section 'C' Short answer type questions. 1. How can one maintain online reputation? Write any two strategies. Ans:- One can maintain online reputation by posting accurate and responsible content. Another strategy is to regularly review and manage privacy settings on social media accounts. 2. Write the importance of digital well-being in any two points. Ans:- Digital well-being helps in maintaining a healthy balance between online and offline life. It also prevents mental and physical health problems caused by excessive use of digital devices. 3. Write any two differences between bit and byte. Ans:- A bit is the smallest unit of digital information representing 0 or 1, while a byte consists of 8 bits. A byte can store more complex data, such as a single character, unlike a bit. 4. Write the process of joining video in brief. Ans:- Joining a video typically involves clicking a meeting link or entering a meeting ID in the video conferencing application. After entering the required credentials, you can join and participate in the video session. 5. Why is cautions necessary for digital well being? Ans:- Caution is necessary to avoid online threats like cyberbullying, scams, and misinformation. It also ensures a healthy and balanced use of digital technology. 6. Write any two positive effects of digital technology on daily life. Ans:- Digital technology makes communication faster and more convenient through messaging and video calls. It also provides easy access to information and online learning resources. 7. Give one-one example of analogue signal and digital signal. Ans:- An example of an analogue signal is radio broadcasting, while an example of a digital signal is computer data transfer. 8. Differentiate between Analogue Signal Transmission and Digital Signal Transmission. Ans:- Analogue signal transmission uses continuous signals to represent data, whereas digital signal transmission uses discrete signals like 0s and 1s. Digital transmission is less affected by noise and more reliable than analogue transmission. 9. Differentiate between Digital well-being and Digital Reputation. Ans:- Digital well-being focuses on maintaining a healthy and balanced use of technology. Digital reputation refers to how a person or organization is perceived based on their online activity. 10. Define the bit and byte used in computer memory. Ans:- A bit is the smallest unit of memory in a computer representing 0 or 1. A byte consists of 8 bits and can store a single character of information. 11. Present the currently used high-speed internet as a Broadband transmission. Ans:- High-speed internet services like fiber optic internet and 4G/5G networks are examples of broadband transmission. They allow multiple data signals to be transmitted simultaneously at high speed. 12. Write the advantages of digital well-being. Ans:- Digital well-being reduces stress and eye strain from excessive screen time. It also improves focus, productivity, and overall mental health.

13. Give two examples of digital reputation management. Ans:- Regularly updating professional profiles on platforms like LinkedIn helps manage digital reputation. Responding politely to online feedback and reviews is another example. 14. Write two effects based on the use and utility of social media. Ans:- Social media helps in connecting with friends, family, and communities globally. It also facilitates sharing knowledge, news, and educational content quickly. 15. Write two possible negative effects of using social media. Ans:- Excessive use of social media can lead to addiction and reduced productivity. It may also expose users to cyberbullying, misinformation, and privacy risks.

Section 'D' Long answer type questions. 1. Explain the working mechanism of baseband transmission with diagram. Ans:- Baseband transmission is a communication method in which the entire bandwidth of the transmission medium is used to send a single signal at a time. In this method, digital signals from the source are first converted into electrical pulses by an encoder. These pulses are then sent through a transmission medium such as a coaxial cable or optical fiber. At the receiving end, a decoder reconstructs the original signal, which is delivered to the output device. Baseband transmission is commonly used in local area networks (LANs) and short-distance communications because it transmits digital signals directly without modulation. Source: Generates the original data signal. Encoder: Converts data into digital pulses. Transmission Medium (Channel): Carries the digital pulses. Decoder: Converts pulses back to the original signal. Output Device: Displays or uses the received information. 2. Write any four characteristics of a good netizen.
